name: Ulkro
desc: Ulkro in a deep hood with the spear-thrower across her forearm and a fan of darts standing in the quiver on her back.

name: Highrim Thrower
desc: Sandstone wraps, a bleached thrower and pale dart shafts, wind-carved like the high rim of the dial.

name: Long Evening Darts
desc: A plum hood and smoked-amber dart heads from the Serenade dusk festival. A rigid lacquered fan stands behind the quiver.
